about.heading: About JaurTools
about.intro1: JaurTools started in 2026 with a simple idea: useful online tools should be free for everyone — the richest and the poorest alike — without signups, downloads, or hidden costs.
about.intro2: Every tool on this site runs 100% in your browser. There is no backend, no database, and nothing you type ever leaves your device. That keeps the tools fast, private, and free to run.
about.metaDescription: JaurTools is a small team building free online tools that run entirely in your browser — no signup, no servers, no data collected.
about.mission: Free tools for everyone — no database, no backend, no money spent — built so that anyone, anywhere, can use them.

benefits.b1: Everything in one place — one bookmark for 630 tools.
benefits.b2: Nothing to install — works on any phone, tablet or computer with a browser.
benefits.b3: No accounts, no upsells — every tool is fully free.
benefits.b4: Your files stay yours — most tools never send anything to a server.

image.text: Need a JPG as PNG for a form? Open the Image Converter, drop the file in, and download the result — the file never leaves your computer.
image.title: Convert an image

loan.text: Thinking about a bike or home loan? Open the Loan EMI Calculator, enter the amount, rate and months, and see the monthly payment instantly.
loan.title: Check a loan payment

s1.title: Start with featured tools

s2.title: Browse the full directory

s3.title: Or just search

limits.l1: Each tool has its own limits — supported file formats, maximum file sizes and calculation ranges are shown on the tool's own page.
limits.l2: Results are only as accurate as the inputs you provide — double-check important numbers before acting on them.
limits.l3: We focus on everyday utility tools. We do not offer video downloaders, AI tools, or a blog — if you see such a claim anywhere, tell us.
limits.l4: This site is a collection of tools, not an encyclopedia — each tool's page explains how that tool works.

about.privacy1: Most JaurTools tools run entirely in your browser. The file or text you put in is processed on your own device and never uploaded to our servers — because there is no server processing your data in the first place.
about.privacy2: That means your documents, numbers and text stay private by design. We do not ask you to create an account, so we do not collect personal details just to let you use a tool. See our Privacy Policy for the full details.
about.quickText: JaurTools is a free collection of online utilities for the small everyday jobs: converting an image, resizing a photo, cleaning up text, checking a website, or working out a number. Pick a tool, use it right in your browser, and move on — nothing to install, nothing to sign up for.
about.story1: JaurTools started in 2026 with a simple idea: useful online tools should be free for everyone — the richest and the poorest alike — without signups, downloads, or hidden costs.
about.story2: We are a small four-person team based in Hyderabad, India. Every tool we build has to pass the same test: it must be genuinely useful, run entirely in the browser, and stay free forever. No logins, no waiting rooms, no locked features.
about.teamIntro: Four people, one mission: free tools for everyone.
